title: Diavgeia MCP Server Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Diavgeia MCP Server

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the Diavgeia API. Can also be set with DIAVGEIA_API_BASE_URL or the legacy DIAVGEIA_URL environment variable.

defaultPageSize.description: Default number of results per page for search queries. Can also be set with DIAVGEIA_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE.

maxOrganizations.description: Maximum number of organizations to display in context. Can also be set with DIAVGEIA_MAX_ORGANIZATIONS.

defaultDateRange.description: Default date range for searches when the user does not provide dates. Can also be set with DIAVGEIA_DEFAULT_DATE_RANGE.

language.description: Preferred language for responses (Greek or English). Can also be set with DIAVGEIA_LANGUAGE.

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Can also be set with DIAVGEIA_TIMEOUT.

cacheEnabled.description: Enable caching of organization data. Can also be set with DIAVGEIA_CACHE_ENABLED.
